source_tags.wheelchair:description: Lift H, ticket hall level (Level -1) to interchange subway (Level -2) for access to Piccadilly and Victoria Lines. For Northern go to main ticket hall; for Circle/Metropolitan/H&C go to St. Pancras Ticket Hall.
Lift J, between the interchange subject (Level -2) and the Piccadilly Line (at Level -3).
The disabled toilet is located on the basement.
Slight ramp from street, wide automatic door. Museum is on a single level. Lift to 1st floor discovery centre. Accessible WC without RADAR key. Step-free to Mail Rail.
Step-free by ramp and wide automatic door. Low counter, movable chairs and tables. May be used without paying to enter museum. Accessible WC without RADAR key.
There’s a lot of stairs and toilet is paid
Lift at the right hand side of the stairwell goes between street level, ticket hall (Level -1) and barrier level (Level -2).
